paragraphs.text: Fixing an unfair will is no sin. Fasting is written for believers, as for those before. Fast for set days. The sick and travelers can fast on other days. The Quran came down in Ramadan. Allah wants ease for you, not hardship. Allah is near. He answers those who call Him.
On Ramadan nights, husbands and wives may be together. Eat and drink until dawn appears. Then fast until sunset. Do not take people's wealth unfairly. New moons mark times for people and Hajj.
Fight those who fight you, but do not go too far. If they stop, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful. Spend in Allah's way. Do good. Allah loves those who do good.
Complete Hajj and umrah for Allah. The sick can fast, give charity or offer an animal. During Hajj, avoid sin and arguing. The best supplies are fear of Allah. Remember Allah after leaving Arafat.

title: Fasting in Ramadan, Fair Limits and Hajj
